column3: Uploads over 50 MiB are refused in the browser, a multi-file upload reloads once even when some fail and names the failures, and AGENTS.md over 20,000 characters blocks Save
column4: XIN-23 review (low): an oversized upload was sent only to be refused, a failed file hid the ones that landed, and an over-cap AGENTS.md would be clipped silently when injected; blocking Save was the lead's pick over clipping
